# Pattern: Announce Progress

At every transition point — stage complete, gate closed, or phase boundary — emit a short progress announcement so the engagement lead can verify nothing was skipped and know what's next.

## Format

```
✅ Done: <one-line summary of what just completed>
🔜 Next: <remaining stages/gates in this phase, or "coverage clear — ready for the next gate">
📋 After this phase: <next phase(s)>
```

Omit the "After this phase" line unless the current item is the last stage in the phase, or a gate just closed.

## When to emit

- After a stage skill publishes an artifact and its Do → Report → Commit step completes
- After a coverage check (`pattern-coverage-check.md`) confirms a phase is ready for its closing gate
- At every phase handoff in the root `discovery` orchestrator (Investigate → Solution → Roadmap)
- After a gate closes (Gate 0 Initiation, Gate 1 Gate Review, Gate 2 Solution Approval, Gate 3 Final Sign-off)

## Why

Discovery sessions are short and spread over days or weeks — the engagement lead returning to a session after a break has no working memory of exactly where the last one left off. A one-line announcement after each confirmed unit lets them spot gaps or drift before starting the next session, without re-reading the whole `Where We Are` tree.
